sloka: इन्द्रजित्तु महामायः सर्वसैन्यसमावृतः ।विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां पितरं चाभ्युपागमत् ।। ६.४६.४६ ।।।।
transliteration: indrajittu mahāmāyaḥ sarvasainyasamāvṛtaḥ ।viveśa nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ pitaraṁ cābhyupāgamat ।। 6.46.46 ।।।।

translations.english: Having reached Ravana, Indrajith greeted him with folded palms and broke the pleasant news, "Rama and Lakshmana are killed."
